artifacts.description: Exact check of the left-permutive identity on the actual seed
F002 held-out accuracies, matched sample sizes

findings.title: R2-02: two-sided coupled windows show no seed-orbit signature in Rule 30
findings.claim: A classifier on 5-column x 8-step two-sided windows can distinguish the single-seed Rule 30 orbit from orbits of random finite rows at held-out times.
findings.scope: Physical frame, columns -2..2, t in [64,4088), 20+20 disjoint random 33-cell rows, logistic and boosted trees, shuffled-label control; rules 30, 90, 150.
findings.result: Rule 30 held-out accuracy 0.499/0.492 (chance). Rule 150 positive control 0.996/0.999. Rule 90 degenerate (near-white).
limitations: Finite windows and times, one window shape, two model families.
Negatives are generic random rows, not matched twins; absence of a statistical signature is not absence of an invariant.

findings.title: R2-02: the seed's column 1 is not more predictable from columns 0/1 than a generic orbit's
findings.claim: The seed's c1(t+1) is more predictable from c0[t-11..t+1], c1[t-11..t] than in generic orbits, indicating a seed-specific inheritance mechanism.
findings.scope: Target leakage excluded (c0(t+2) omitted). Train t in [76,2048), test [2048,4094); generic baseline from disjoint random orbits at matched training size 1972; rules 30, 90, 150.
findings.result: Rule 30 boosted accuracy 0.876 seed vs 0.895 generic: no seed-specific excess. Rule 150 seed 0.959 vs generic 0.514 (positive control). Rule 90 degenerate.
limitations: Single RNG seed, no error bars.
Finite windows; does not rule out nonlocal or long-range inheritance.
findings.next_action: Stop; inheritance is not visible as local statistical coupling.

findings.title: R2-02: columns 0 and 1 cannot be jointly eventually periodic; Problem 1 reduces to column-1 inheritance
findings.claim: For Rule 30 from the single seed there are no T>=0, P>0 with columns 0 and 1 both P-periodic from T. Hence Problem 1 follows from: column 0 eventually periodic implies column 1 eventually periodic.
findings.scope: Exact seed, physical frame. Paper proof via left-permutivity, the light cone and the always-black left edge. Not kernel checked; likely already known.
findings.result: Paper proof in REPORT.md. The left-permutive identity checked exactly on the seed for 126 columns x 600 steps: 0 mismatches.
limitations: Reformulation-strength; the inheritance lemma may be as hard as Problem 1.
findings.next_action: Formalize the joint-periodicity lemma in Lean; then attack inheritance through the driven right half using the inverse-OR domain where c1(t)=0.
